sources.title: mudler/KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev-APEX-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: I host 30+ free APEX MoE quantizations as independent research. My only local hardware is an NVIDIA DGX Spark (122 GB unified memory) — enough for ~30-50B-class MoEs, but bigger ones (200B+) require rented compute on H100/H200/Blackwell, typically $20-100 per quant.

sources.title: [2607.05471] KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present KAT-Coder-V2.5, a coding-focused agentic model trained to act autonomously inside real, executable repositories rather than as a single-turn code generator. Its capability is bottlenecked less by model scale than by the scarcity of reproducible environments, verifiable rewards, and high-value trajectories, which we address with an end-to-end agentic post-training framework ...
